verses.text: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the wicked, Nor standeth in the way of sinners, Nor sitteth in the seat of scoffers:

segments.text: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the wicked,
Nor standeth in the way of sinners,
Nor sitteth in the seat of scoffers:

verses.text: But his delight is in the law of Jehovah; And on his law doth he meditate day and night.

segments.text: But his delight is in the law of Jehovah;
And on his law doth he meditate day and night.

verses.text: And he shall be like a tree planted by the streams of water, That bringeth forth its fruit in its season, Whose leaf also doth not wither; And whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

segments.text: And he shall be like a tree planted by the streams of water,
That bringeth forth its fruit in its season,
Whose leaf also doth not wither;
And whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

verses.text: The wicked are not so, But are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

segments.text: But are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

verses.text: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

segments.text: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment,
Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

verses.text: For Jehovah knoweth the way of the righteous; But the way of the wicked shall perish.

segments.text: For Jehovah knoweth the way of the righteous;
But the way of the wicked shall perish.
